Name: The Oracle's Forest Farm
Author: AshesForAshe
Description:
[b][i][size=4]These maps havent been updated since 2018/2019 and are not guaranteed to work with any updates since then, or outside of single-player mode. I have no intent of getting back into modding, sorry!
[/size][/i][/b]

Hello everyone,

This is another farm layout made by me to complement the '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3140]House of the Oracle[/url]' house edit but can be used by itself. I made these 2 mods to create a more witchy/magical vibe on my farm.

This file replaces the original Forest/Foraging Farm layout.
Inside the .zip is a content pack file compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. To use Content Patcher you also need SMAPI installed. I'm using Content Patcher to avoid overwriting original game files, so you're not losing anything and can go back to the original game easily. (Thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/12748973-arjay0/]arjay0[/url] for explaining CP to me)

If you do [b]NOT [/b]want to use Content Patcher do the following:
- Go to your game folder StardewValley/content/maps
- find the Farm_Foraging.xnb file, copy this to a safe place as a backup.
- copy the Farm_Foraging.xnb file, within the mod folder, to the Maps folder.
- You don't need to use the config or manifest files in the mod folder.
The game should now load the layout under foraging farm.

Have fun!
